Round N3, completion. This world continues dw_428a99e55a4f (round N3), which kept cand-h4 on the held-out papers
paper_8 and paper_26 (evaluation record and release 94b91bb). Three parts of N3's objective did not run because of
two host supply problems that the host has now fixed (problems.md P1 and P4). This round runs those three parts and
nothing else: no new diagnosis, no new candidate. Everything else of N3's objective stands as written: the task
settings (a world continued at c0 with only the two workers changed, `"resources": []`, budget.total_seconds 1800, at
most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds, worker.image sha256:1c386c95ad418958d152047d267775b0ef0ee7813594751b539bf3bebb1e2abd),
the isolation of held-out and final-test material, the judging (rubric v2, every content item reported apart, the
verifier as a sanity floor, calibration before scoring, blind labels whose table is published only after every
judgement is pushed, one judge line: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, effort high, through HuTian's own Codex login, no fallback;
when the line answers overload the world waits) and the keep rule.

**The fixes.** P1: the rebuilt environment images now carry the host's hutian label, with the same files as before:
paper_29 sha256:731fc3cf0ffdd477350c2b182fe3cb4027776229711458079fe03ddf68dae8fa (pwb-paper29-env:i357l, same layers as
893eb3b5…) and paper_39 sha256:beda8c04d6233549880607d1f5e4f2eabb26ccc224def7ddffa2924fa74464ad (pwb-paper39-env:i357l,
same layers as 47e4c66f…). P4: cand-a's two worker files are in the test-material resource, cand-a/ (cand-a/README.md).

1. **Held-out paper_39.** Run cand-g2, cand-h2 and cand-h4 5 times each from rw_19be25bd2f7d at c0 with
   worker.environment_image set to the paper_39 image above, make and score its calibration draft first, and judge
   the 15 results blind as N3 judged paper_8 and paper_26. Then apply the keep rule over the three held-out papers
   paper_39, paper_8 and paper_26 (paper_8 and paper_26 as N3's record scored them), with every number the rule asks
   for. The worker kept is the one the rule picks over the three papers; if that is not cand-h4, say so and deliver it.
2. **Put-back into the named world.** Once the rule has picked, put the kept worker back into rw_313df9cf84a4 at c0
   (not at `before-stop-a0cbf9ca`), with worker.environment_image set to the paper_29 image above. It counts only if
   its records show the kept worker producing new output. N3's put-back on rw_06110020973f stays as recorded; this one
   is the objective's.
3. **Final test with cand-a.** Run cand-a (cand-a/cand-a-writer/v1/worker.json for paper-repo,
   cand-a/cand-a-reviewer/v1/worker.json for internal-review-repo) 5 times on paper_38 from rw_999511721bf2 at c0, and
   the kept worker 5 times too if it is neither cand-h4 nor cand-g2. Then judge every final-test manuscript, N3's 15
   (incumbent@v3, cand-g2, cand-h4) and the new ones, blind and together under new labels, so all generations are
   scored by one reading. It decides nothing.

Parts 1 and 3 can run at the same time; part 2 waits for the rule. **Budget**: about 5 h of work in the
36000 s of this world, including an hour of provider stall; have the release done well before it.
